description: Calculates Cyprus income tax, employee/self-employed SI, GESY and take-home pay. Employee SI and first-employment relief use qualifying employment remuneration only; rent does not increase employee SI. GESY uses the shared €180,000 personal ceiling. Use for a Cyprus resident or non-resident employee or sole proprietor tax estimate. Before calling, confirm whether a stated salary is monthly or annual and confirm employment category (private, civil or self-employed); do not infer either. Supply gross annual salary in EUR (use explicit 0 for self-employed-only cases); self-employed calculations also need turnover and occupational category. Identify when 2026 tax rules are a default rather than a user-supplied year. Optional incomes, deductions, tax year and eligibility facts must come from the user. Employee Social Insurance applies to qualifying employment remuneration only; passive rental income does not increase employee SI. Article 8(21A)/(23A) exemptions are based on qualifying employment remuneration only; GESY's €180,000 annual personal ceiling is shared across salary, self-employment, pension and income-earner categories. Never infer exemption eligibility. Household tax category differs from marital status; confirm family income, custody and dividend profit origin. Missing facts appear in statutoryAssumptions and require review.

alreadyTaxedOtherDividends.description: Already SDC-taxed amount within the remaining dividend allocation.

alreadyTaxedPre2026CyprusDividends.description: Already SDC-taxed amount within the pre-2026 Cyprus-profit allocation; not merely this year's withholding.

cryptoTradingIncome.description: Annual taxable cryptoasset trading gains in EUR. From tax year 2026 the amount is taxed at 8% separately from progressive PIT; do not include non-taxable investment disposals.

depositInterestIncome.description: Annual deposit interest in EUR. Standard interest is subject to 17% SDC for Cyprus-domiciled individuals, rather than progressive PIT; GESY still applies.

donations.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

employmentType.description: 'private' for private sector (8.8% SI), 'civil' for civil service (4.45% SI), 'self-employed' for sole proprietor (16.6% SI on deemed/actual, 4% GESY). Required; the API does not assume a category.

exemptionType.description: Minds in Cyprus Art. 8(21B), applied only when eligibility conditions are met.

familyIncome.description: Total relevant statutory family income for Article 14B eligibility. Includes applicable income outside the calculator streams; do not add an ex-partner outside this household.

fullCustodyChildOrders.description: One-based eligible-child positions qualifying for sole-custody doubling within a family. Do not combine with single-parent status, which doubles all eligible children.

householdChildrenForThreshold.description: Children counted for family threshold, at least the eligible deduction-child count.

innovativeInvestment.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

isNonDomicile.description: Cyprus non-domicile status; exempts rental and deposit-interest SDC where applicable.

mindsEligibility.description: Facts used to validate Minds in Cyprus Art. 8(21B). Omit or leave incomplete to receive no 8(21B) deduction.

cyprusStartDate.description: Date the Cyprus employment or business began.

cyprusTaxResidentInClaimYear.description: Cyprus tax resident in the claim year; not required for the commencement year.

first12MonthsQualifyingIncome.description: Qualifying Cyprus remuneration or business profits in the first 12 months after starting.

fullTimeForeignEmploymentMonthsPrior84.description: Months of full-time foreign employment during the preceding 84 months.

nonResidentForPriorSevenYears.description: Not Cyprus tax resident throughout the seven years before starting.

recognizedUniversityDegree.description: Holds a degree recognized by the Cyprus Council for the Recognition of Higher Education Qualifications.

residentBeforePriorSevenYears.description: Cyprus tax resident in a year before those seven years.

pre2026CyprusDividendIncome.description: Portion of total dividends from pre-2026 Cyprus-company profits distributed in 2026, subject to transitional 17% SDC. Foreign dividends belong in the remaining 5% portion. Explicit 0 confirms no transitional portion; omission produces a review assumption.

providentFund.description: Total provident/PEPP fund contribution in EUR.

selfEmployedDetails.description: Sole-proprietor schedule: net profit = turnover − expenses − capitalAllowances − lossBroughtForward (floor 0).

occupationalCategory.description: Official year-specific MLSI occupational category driving weekly deemed earnings. Ask for the actual occupation and use the up-to/over-10-years variant where the schedule distinguishes practice duration.

useActualEarningsForSI.description: Pay SI on actual profit when higher than deemed.

taxHouseholdCategory.description: Statutory household status, not marital status. Equal shared custody uses family; single-parent requires the statutory definition. If omitted, the estimate reports a review assumption.

tradeUnionSubs.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

name: calculate_cyprus_income_tax
